question: What post-subagent completion hook contract should OpenClaw support, if any, and how should it bound child output/history exposure plus announcement mutation, suppression, and delivery-result visibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but event naming, payload shape, redaction, timeout/error handling, audit behavior, plugin authority, and compatibility with broader lifecycle work are public API and security-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Typed Plugin Delivery Hook
options.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Lifecycle Design
options.body: Hold this request until the broader lifecycle-hook design at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43454 settles one event model across subagents, turns, and tool thresholds.

options.title: Observation-Only Event
options.body: Expose only a non-mutating completion event and leave announcement mutation or suppression to separate delivery-policy work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13911.

recommendation.title: Typed Plugin Delivery Hook
recommendation.body: Add a bounded typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent/thread-binding work, hook docs, and the guard-hook PR close rationale make this the strongest available routing signal for the API/security contract choice.
